title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce)
description:
About us

First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations across industries such as healthcare, real estate, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e-commerce.

Our projects are as diverse as our people — and we believe in building software through collaboration, transparency, and shared success.

Let's see what we can create together!


About the project

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce) to join a long-term project and support the improvement of deployment processes across multiple systems, including Salesforce and web applications .

In this role, you will work closely with an existing DevOps setup and client-side leadership, contributing to automation, reliability, and efficient delivery pipelines. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys improving workflows, reducing manual effort, and working independently within a collaborative environment.


Responsibilities

  • Drive improvements in deployment workflows across Salesforce and other applications, reducing manual steps and increasing reliability
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines , including solutions tailored for Salesforce
  • Improve and maintain version control practices to ensure traceability and safe rollbacks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen DevOps culture and best practices
  • Support release management, monitoring, and environment stability (SRE-related tasks)
  • Ensure security and compliance standards are followed across deployments
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve automation, performance, and delivery processes


Requirements

  • Strong experience with DevOps practices and process improvement
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce DX, SF CLI, and Developer Tools , including deployments and configurations
  • Experience building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (YAML/JSON), preferably with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform)
  • Solid experience working with Azure (App Services, KeyVault, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, VNet)
  • Nice to have: exposure to AWS or GCP
  • Scripting skills in PowerShell and/or Bash
  • Strong understanding of version control systems (Git or similar)
  • Experience supporting release management and monitoring (SRE concepts)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently in a distributed team


What we can offer

The FLS difference

  • Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging
  • Gain access to our diverse range of training programs, courses, and certifications
  • Choose your work style - remote, on-site or hybrid in one of our stunning offices.
  • Enhance your language skills with our corporate English classes
  • Work from anywhere and explore the world with our Workation program

title: Líder técnico
description:
Vaga: Tech Lead

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead para atuar como referência técnica, liderando squads e apoiando o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta qualidade.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente times de desenvolvimento
  • Apoiar definição de arquitetura e padrões técnicos
  • Garantir qualidade de código, boas práticas e evolução das soluções
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas complexos e decisões técnicas
  • Conectar áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócio

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e atuação como Tech Lead ou referência técnica
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de aplicações, APIs e integrações

  • Experiência com pipelines, testes, versionamento e entrega contínua
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com microsserviços, cloud e arquitetura distribuída
  • Vivência em transformação digital e sistemas de alta volumetria

Buscamos um profissional com liderança técnica, visão estratégica, perfil hands-on e capacidade de influenciar times e decisões.

title: Especialista .NET
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro Especialista de Software


Se você busca atuar em projetos desafiadores, com tecnologias modernas e em um ambiente global, essa oportunidade é para você.


O que buscamos:

Profissional com forte experiência em desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET (versões 8/9), com visão de arquitetura, boas práticas de engenharia e foco em entrega de valor ao usuário final.


Principais responsabilidades e competências:

  • Desenvolvimento de serviços backend robustos e escaláveis com .NET
  • Atuação com tecnologias frontend como React, Angular ou Blazor
  • Experiência com ambientes em contêineres (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Conhecimento em design de APIs, integrações e práticas de qualidade para produção
  • Atuação em ambientes multiculturais e distribuídos
  • Interface direta com clientes, apoiando na definição de soluções e direcionamento técnico
  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka/MQTT)
  • Vivência com integrações industriais (shopfloor) ou soluções de IoT

*Inglês fluente (nível C1) para comunicação diária


Perfil comportamental:

  • Autonomia e proatividade
  • Comunicação clara e orientação a resultados
  • Colaboração em times multidisciplinares
  • Capacidade de lidar com requisitos evolutivos

Ambiente de atuação:

Projetos globais, times distribuídos e forte interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Graduação ou nível superior

Certificações são um diferencial.


100% REMOTA

title: Fonoaudiólogo
description:
Venha impactar vidas com a gente!


Se você busca crescimento profissional e deseja atuar em uma empresa com propósito , essa oportunidade é para você!


A Comunicare Aparelhos Auditivos é o varejo do Grupo WSA , líder mundial na indústria de aparelhos auditivos. Nosso propósito é impactar vidas por meio de uma reabilitação auditiva de excelência , devolvendo o prazer de escutar e melhorando a qualidade de vida de milhares de pessoas.


Estamos presentes em mais de 100 lojas no Brasil e também no Chile, México e Argentina , com atuação sólida, inovadora e em constante expansão.


Quer fazer parte de uma empresa que muda histórias todos os dias?

Confira nossas oportunidades e venha crescer com a gente!


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um Fonoaudiólogo para atuar com atendimento a clientes, realização de exames e adaptação e venda de aparelhos auditivos.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente
  • Realizar testes relacionados ao uso de próteses auditivas
  • Ajustar as próteses auditivas de acordo com a audiometria do cliente
  • Inspecionar e enviar aparelhos auditivos para manutenção
  • Venda e pós-venda


O que buscamos:

  • Graduação concluída em Fonoaudiologia
  • Interesse em atuar com aparelhos auditivos
  • Habilidade com tecnologia: pacote office e sistemas gerais


Benefícios:

  • Pacote de benefícios completo e diferenciado, pensado para proporcionar mais tranquilidade e qualidade de vida, sem impacto financeiro para o colaborador.


Informações adicionais da vaga:

  • Locais: Belém PA, Anápolis GO, Londrina PR, Rio Grande-RS, São Paulo-SP e Coberturas MG.
  • Modelo: presencial
  • Jornada: 40 horas semanais
  • Regime: CLT | Efetivo



Também temos oportunidades em outras localidades!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Software Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


We are looking for a kind, curious, and experienced Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving challenging problems and building impactful user experiences. You’ll join a collaborative and supportive engineering team focused on making it seamless and compelling for users to engage with our platform.

This is a fully remote role reporting to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience, with strong opportunities for technical leadership, mentorship, and personal growth .


What You’ll Do

  • Write high-quality, scalable, and testable code that drives key business initiatives
  • Contribute hands-on while also helping shape the technical direction of the team
  • Build and maintain features using modern technologies such as:
  • Elixir, Ruby
  • React, TypeScript, GraphQL
  • Kafka, AWS (Lambda)
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB
  • Participate in architecture and design decisions
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate closely with teammates through pair programming
  • Deploy and monitor user-facing features in production
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies and patterns


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in Elixir or Ruby
  • Solid experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
  • Hands-on experience with React and its ecosystem (Node.js, npm)
  • Familiarity with:
  • RESTful APIs
  • Git and version control workflows
  • TypeScript
  • Remote deployment tools
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures , databases , and GraphQL
  • A problem-solving mindset with a focus on user impact
  • Interest in e-commerce, retail, or building sustainable digital ecosystems


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kafka (event streaming)
  • Experience transitioning from monoliths to microservices architectures


Why Join Us

  • Work with a supportive and collaborative team that values growth
  • Have real influence on technical decisions and product direction
  • Be part of a mission-driven environment focused on innovation and sustainability
  • Continuous opportunities for learning, mentorship, and career development

title: Nutricionista
description:
VAGA EXCLUSIVA PARA NUTRICIONISTA.


Estamos em busca de um nutricionista que tenha paixão por compartilhar conhecimento e transformar vidas por meio da educação em saúde natural.


O profissional ideal terá habilidade de comunicação, experiência na criação de conteúdos em vídeo e aulas, e interesse em crescer junto com a Mahile, ampliando nossa presença nas redes sociais.


Responsabilidades


Realizar gravações de aulas, vídeos e campanhas institucionais;

Participar da criação e revisão de conteúdos científicos e educativos sobre suplementação e saúde natural;

Atender pacientes ou clientes em consultas individuais, conforme a demanda;

Representar a Mahile como autoridade em saúde;

Contribuir com ideias e feedbacks para o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e protocolos.


Qualificações


Formação superior;

(desejável);

Experiência em atendimento clínico e conhecimento em suplementação e nutrição;

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

Conforto diante das câmeras e experiência em gravações de vídeo.


Requisitos


Disponibilidade para gravação de vídeos e aulas em ambiente profissional;

Comprometimento com prazos e entregas;

Interesse genuíno por saúde natural e educação em bem-estar;

Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe de forma remota;

Autorização para uso de imagem, voz e nome nos conteúdos da marca durante o período de contrato.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Engenharia de Software SR - Salesforce Marketing Cloud


Descrição da vaga

Você se identifica com a área de Engenharia de Software e possui como propósito ajudar pessoas a construir um time com uma forte cultura de engenharia de software, que agregue cada vez mais valor aos negócios?


#LI-LR1

#LI-REMOTE


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Ser uma referência técnica para os times em que atua, sendo proativo e exercendo a liderança junto ao time, comunicando-se com diferentes papéis e níveis hierárquicos.
  • Propor soluções compatíveis com os desafios técnicos e de negócio.
  • Aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia de software, alinhada com as diretrizes do time arquitetura.
  • Colaborar com outros times, promovendo alinhamento e comunicação clara.

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

title: Oracle EPM Technical Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Technical Consultant to design, develop, integrate, and support Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Cloud solutions.

The role involves working closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders to deliver technical solutions using EPM integrations, business rules, data management, reporting tools, and automation frameworks .

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Oracle EPM Cloud technical tools and architecture , along with proven experience delivering end-to-end implementations and post-production support .

title: 1st Level Tech Support Agent
description:
Bookmap is a market depth visualisation and high-speed trading platform, providing complete market transparency and incomparable insight into the actions and intentions of equities, futures, and crypto traders.

Built to help traders make informed decisions, gain competitive advantage, and ensure consistent success, it has become the industry-leading software for order book and order flow analysis.


We are currently looking to hire a 1st Level Tech Support Agent , to join our growing team and cover US time zones.


Responsibilities


This role is 100% remote and includes shifts


As a 1st level customer support agent, your tasks will focus on looking after, supporting and advising our international customers from the crypto/stocks/futures trading environment.


You will receive functional and technical inquiries and faults via the live chat, by e-mail and occasionally by telephone, process them independently or forward them to the right contact person conscientiously.


Required skills and experience

  • Background in Computer Science, Economics, Finance or other related field
  • Experience in the area of customer support, ideally for software products
  • Technical interest in complex software is desirable
  • Good command of the English language, both written and verbal
  • Solution-oriented
  • Structured way of working 
  • Team spirit
  • Commitment


The below would be considered an advantage

  • Interest or experience in trading financial instruments(crypto, futures, etc)
  • A second foreign language


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave
  • Equipment and software reimbursement, with flexible options to suit your needs
  • Opportunities for professional development, including language courses and training programs
  • A collaborative, international team and a supportive work culture


The hiring process consists of 3 steps:

1.After applying, successful candidates will be asked to answer a short questionnaire

2.Those who pass the first stage will be required to complete a paid test task

3. Interview with our team

title: Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles;
  • Strong experience with data pipeline design and development (batch and streaming);
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing;
  • Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational data modeling;
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar);
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, or similar);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and lakehouse architectures;
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality practices;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


Nice to have

  • Experience with dbt, Delta Lake, or Apache Iceberg;
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink);
  • Knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar);


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados AWS
description:
Profissional para construir e escalar pipelines em Databricks/Spark na AWS, suportando iniciativas de AI/ML e projetos de analytics/BI, em colaboração com times globais.

  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar pipelines em Databricks/Spark (batch/streaming) com qualidade, performance e observabilidade.
  • Integrar e orquestrar dados na AWS (S3, Glue, Athena/Redshift), garantindo governança e segurança.
  • Construir datasets e pipelines para AI/ML (feature engineering, dados para treino e inferência).

  • Domínio de Databricks e Apache Spark em produção.
  • Experiência prática com a stack AWS para dados/analytics.
  • Forte base em SQL e Python, com boas práticas de versionamento e CI/CD de dados.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para reuniões com times globais.

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: DevOps Consultant
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

DevOps Pleno


Responsabilidades

Projetar e manter soluções de monitoramento e telemetria para aplicações e infraestrutura.

Implementar e gerenciar Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics e Container Insights.

Criar dashboards, alertas e relatórios personalizados para acompanhamento de performance.

Implementar observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Azure Functions, Logic Apps e App Services).

Monitorar ambientes Kubernetes / AKS com coleta de métricas, logs e rastreamento distribuído.

Automatizar provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM).

Definir e acompanhar SLO, SLI e SLA para aplicações críticas.

Integrar ferramentas de monitoramento com pipelines de CI/CD.

Implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, MTTR e Change Failure Rate).


Requisitos Técnicos

Azure Monitor

Application Insights

Log Analytics

Container Insights

Observabilidade em ambientes Azure

Kubernetes / AKS

Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM)

Integração com pipelines DevOps (CI/CD)

Azure Functions e Azure Logic Apps

Monitoramento de performance de aplicações (APM)

Métricas DORA e indicadores de confiabilidade


Formato de trabalho: Remoto


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Vmware Consultant
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced VMware NSX Consultant to join our team on a contract basis. In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert driving the architecture, deployment, and optimization of VMware NSX environments. You'll play a critical role in shaping network virtualization strategies, leading technical engagements, and delivering scalable, secure solutions across private and hybrid cloud infrastructures.

Responsibilities


Architecture & Deployment

  • Lead end-to-end architecture, design, and deployment of VMware NSX and Aria Operations for Networks
  • Design and implement multi-site architectures including network provisioning, workload management, configuration management, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Integrate NSX with third-party platforms spanning infrastructure, storage, networking, and security solutions


Operations & Management

  • Oversee deployment, configuration, and ongoing management of NSX and Aria Operations for Networks
  • Develop and enforce micro-segmentation policies to strengthen network security posture
  • Ensure adherence to industry standards, security policies, and compliance requirements


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Lead technical discussions, workshops, and knowledge transfer sessions for internal teams
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide guidance on troubleshooting and optimization
  • Participate in pre-sales engagements to scope and position NSX-based networking solutions
  • Develop and deliver technical documentation, design documents, and deployment best practices


Experience

  • 15+ years of hands-on technical experience with VMware and supporting technologies
  • 5+ years as a network engineer or architect
  • Proven experience deploying, upgrading, and managing NSX-T environments
  • Experience migrating NSX-V to NSX-T environments
  • Hands-on experience with Aria Operations for Networks (vRNI) for traffic analysis and micro-segmentation
  • Experience installing, configuring, and managing virtual networks and virtual load balancers
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to lead cross-functional technical discussions


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field


Certifications

  • Required: VCP-NV
  • Preferred: VCP-DCV, VCP-CMA, VCAP-DCV, VCAP-CMA, VCDX-NV, VCP-VCF, VCAP-NV

title: SFDC Developer JR/PL
description:
Come to one of the largest IT services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make a difference, which is why we live in a culture of unlimited learning and full of opportunities for mutual improvement and development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a SFDC Developer JR/PL @ Brazil- Remote Opportunity, who wants to learn and transform their career.

Job Title: SFDC Developer JR/PL

Experience : 2+ Years

Location : Remote-Brazil

Language : Fluent/Advanced English


Key Responsibility:

\"Experience in Administration, Configuration, Implementation and experience with Salesforce platform.

● Experience in Salesforce Customization, Security Access, Workflow Approvals, Data Validation, and data utilities.

● Expertise in SFDC Development using Apex Language, Visual Force pages, Classes, Controllers, Triggers, Indexes, Web Services, Components, Tabs, Apex Web services, Custom Objects, Reports, Analytic Snapshots and Dashboards, Profiles, Creating Roles, Page Layouts, Org - Wide default, Sharing rules, Workflows

● Experience in implementing Salesforce SOQL, SOSL and dynamic queries in Apex logic

● Experience in writing test classes for maximum code coverage

● Experience in Integration Methodologies, different API, Trigger framework, Recursive Triggers, VF Remoting, Asynchronous Framework – Batch jobs, Queueable Apex, future methods

● Experience in setting up Connected App

● Experience in Sales Cloud, Field Service and CPQ, Ant Migration tool, Standard and custom controllers, Data Loader, Force.com, Eclipse IDE Plug-in, VS Code, Workflow-Approval, Custom objects, Custom tabs, Email service, Html, Web-service (REST and SOAP)

● Experience in debugging the code for troubleshooting the issues

Good to Have:

● 2+ years of experience in Salesforce Lightning, Lightning Design System, Lightning App Builder and Lightning Component features.

● Experience Lightning Process builder flows, Chatter and quick Action

● Salesforce Certified Administrator Certification

● Salesforce Advanced Administrator Certification

● Salesforce Platform App Builder Certification

● Salesforce Platform Developer I1 Certification\"


What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation voucher
  • Meal/food vouchers
  • Childcare
  • Ginásio Pass
  • TCS GemsTCS Cares – toll-free 0800 that offers psychological (24 hours/day), legal, social and financial assistance to members
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online Courses & Live Training
  • Opportunity for international experience

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring your friend – By referring people, you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, always working for equity. This goes for Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We thought of different inclusion and social responsibility actions in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come be a TCSer!

We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. #welcometoyourfuture

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar;
  • 4+ years of experience in Java development;
  • Experience with Spring frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security);
  • Experience with microservice architecture and cloud platforms;
  • Good English skills (minimum B2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal with our support.


Nice to have

  • Strong experience with Angular 2+.

  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;

  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


Desenvolver e executar análises de dados de ponta a ponta para múltiplas áreas da empresa, incluindo operações, pagamentos e marketing, utilizando principalmente SQL , Google Sheets e Looker Platform . Criar, corrigir e otimizar tabelas, pipelines e regras de negócio, assegurando integridade, performance e escalabilidade. Usar métodos estatísticos e algoritmos de machine learning para criar modelos preditivos. Validar dados e indicadores críticos, investigando inconsistências e propondo melhorias. Colaborar com áreas de negócio, traduzindo análises em insights claros e acionáveis. Contribuir para boas práticas de versionamento e documentação utilizando GitHub . Experiência avançada em SQL e BigQuery ou SQL Server , além de experiência avançada em R . Habilidade para traduzir análises complexas em informações compreensíveis e proatividade para acompanhar indicadores.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Experiência em análises que envolvem múltiplas áreas de negócio. Vivência em GitHub , Looker ou outras ferramentas de data visualization . Capacidade de resolver problemas com foco em resultados para o negócio. Experiência em digital analytics com ferramentas como Google Analytics , Google Tag Manager e Appsflyer . Conhecimento em técnicas avançadas de ETL e transformação de dados .


Resumo dos requisitos: SQL , Google Sheets , Looker Platform , Machine Learning , GitHub , R , BigQuery , SQL Server , Google Analytics , Google Tag Manager , Appsflyer .

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior


Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior , sua missão será atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento de soluções, participando da conceituação, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação de projetos existentes e de novas iniciativas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web multiusuário eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;
  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, confiáveis, seguros e completamente aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa. Aplicação de conceitos de reuso;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenção do código, zelando pela documentação do mesmo e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Graduação Completa em: Tecnologia da Informação, Desenvolvimento de Software, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas em TI.
  • Experiência de 6 anos em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App);
  • Linguagem de Programação Java ;
  • Desenvolvimento frontend JavaScript, HMTL, CSS. Jquery e React;
  • Capacidade de interpretação do código-fonte elaborado por outros;
  • Experiência em Cloud AWS;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento GIT;
  • APIs Rest;
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados SQL;
  • Maven;
  • Persistência Objeto-Relacional (Hibernate, JPA);



REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS


  • Sistema de Identidade (Ex: KeyCloak)
  • Bibliotecas de Log (Ex: Log4J);
  • Container (Docker);
  • Atuação com frameworks Spring (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring);
  • Ter atuado em projetos utilizando metodologia ágil Scrum

title: AI Trainer
description:
We are looking for motivated individuals residing in Brazil to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers . This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who are native Portuguese speakers and eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence.


Role Overview

As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent.
  • Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness.
  • Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese.
  • Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses.


Requirements

  • Language: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Location: Must be a current resident of Brazil .
  • Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!).
  • Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines.
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools.
  • Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet.


Compensation & Benefits


  • Rate: $4 USD per hour .
  • Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil with a schedule that fits your studies or other commitments.
  • Experience: Gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas.


Benefícios

Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)

VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash

Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto do projeto:

A DataEX busca empresa/profissional autônomo para prestação de serviços técnicos especializados em projeto na área de Dados, com atuação junto a cliente de grande porte, no contexto de iniciativas de Análise de Dados. A eventual relação jurídica será formalizada mediante contrato civil de prestação de serviços, com autonomia técnica e operacional.


Perfil técnico esperado:

  • Vasta experiência em análise de dados e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Experiência em mentoria e desenvolvimento de times.
  • Profundo conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados (Power BI).
  • Experiência na definição e implementação de estratégias analíticas.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional.
  • Experiência em levantamento e entendimento de requisitos de negócio.
  • Vivência com consumo e manipulação de dados em ambientes de Big Data .
  • Experiência com Data Warehouses (ex: Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse ou similares).
  • Experiência com Data Lakes / Lakehouses (ex: Amazon S3, Athena, Glue, Azure Data Lake, Databricks ou similares).
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou similares), de acordo com o contexto do projeto.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de traduzir dados em insights e influenciar decisões estratégicas.


Escopo de atuação:

  • Realizar e validar requisitos de negócio.
  • Realizar e validar a modelagem dimensional (conceitual, lógica e fisica).
  • Executar projetos analíticos, desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de análise de dados.
  • Colaborar com líderes de negócios para identificar oportunidades de análise.
  • Apresentar insights e recomendações para stakeholders.

title: Delivery Manager (Internacional)
description:
A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência em consultoria de tecnologia e com contato direto com clientes
  • Background técnico em desenvolvimento de software
  • Habilidade de negociação
  • Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial
  • Conhecimento em OKRs
  • Experiência com métricas de performance
  • Familiaridade com NPS



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack - Node e React (PL)
description:
Código da vaga: 59746


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Requisitos Técnicos:

O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de aplicações web para a área de pós vendas,

Front-end: React e Next.js com Chakra UI, aplicando boas práticas de componentização e responsividade Back-end: Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços em NestJS, executando sobre Node.js

Experiencia com TypeScript, com sólida base em JavaScript

Diferencial: Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e bancos de dados PostgreSQL


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
  • Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision .
  • Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize .
  • Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Strong decision-making capability and accountability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.


Contract & Work Model

  • PJ (contractor) model
  • Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable
  • Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Principal Data Consultant – Life Sciences
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Principal Data Consultant – Life Sciences (PIM/MDM) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

  • Strategic Consulting: Act as the primary advisor for PIM, MDM, and Data Syndication frameworks, ensuring alignment with Life Sciences regulatory standards and commercial goals.
  • Analysis & Architecture: Execute deep-dive business analysis to translate stakeholder requirements into scalable technical roadmaps.
  • Stakeholder Management: Deliver expert-level communication to executive leadership, navigating complex project lifecycles with clarity and precision.
  • Ecosystem Optimization: Oversee the integration of product data across global syndication channels to enhance data integrity and speed-to-market.



Mandatory Skills:

  • We are seeking a high-caliber Senior Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead strategic initiatives within the Life Sciences domain.
  • This role requires a seasoned consultant capable of bridging the gap between complex data ecosystems and business objectives.
  • The ideal candidate will possess a decade of experience driving digital transformation through robust data management strategies.


Desirable Skills:

  • 8+ years in Life Sciences (Pharmaceuticals/Consumer Health).
  • Technical: Advanced mastery of Product Information Management (PIM), Master Data Management (MDM), and global data syndication tools.
  • Exceptional analytical mindset with a proven track record in high-level consulting and cross-functional leadership

description:
Come to one of the largest IT services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make a difference, which is why we live in a culture of unlimited learning and full of opportunities for mutual improvement and development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Backend/ Integration Developer @ Remote- Brazil, who wants to learn and transform their career at TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES .


Job Description:

Job Title: Backend/ Integration Developer

Experience : 5+ Years

Location : Remote -Brazil

Language : Fluent/Advanced English

Employment Type: (Permanent)


Integration Developer – IBM App Connect (ESB)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Integration Developer with strong expertise in IBM App

Connect Enterprise (ACE) to design, develop, and deliver scalable integration solutions

across global enterprise platforms.

This role is part of the Global Integration Engineering team and focuses on enabling API-led,

event-driven, and cloud-native integrations that support enterprise digital transformation

initiatives. The ideal candidate brings a strong integration mindset, hands-on ESB

experience, and working knowledge of cloud platforms, automation, and modern

development practices.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and develop cloud-ready and hybrid integration solutions using IBM App

Connect / ACE.

• Build and expose RESTful APIs, event-driven services, and asynchronous integrations

aligned to enterprise architecture standards.

• Implement modern integration patterns including API-led connectivity, event

streaming, pub/sub, and request–reply.

• Develop integrations that are secure, scalable, resilient, and observable in cloud and

hybrid environments.

• Work closely with architects to evolve integration standards and support cloud

adoption and modernization initiatives.

• Integrate enterprise systems using messaging, APIs, file transfer, and streaming

technologies.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and infrastructure-aware

integration design.

• Support non-functional requirements including performance, high availability,

disaster recovery, and security.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Cloud, DevOps, Security, QA, Product, and

Business).

• Participate in troubleshooting, production support, and continuous improvement of

integration platforms.

• Provide technical guidance and promote best practices across the integration

community.

• Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and adoption of integration best

practices across the organization.

Core Skills & Experience (Required)

• Strong hands-on experience with IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM

Integration Bus (IIB).

• Proven expertise in:

o ESQL, DFDL

o REST & SOAP APIs

o JSON, XML, XSLT

o IBM MQ, JMS, HTTP/S

• Deep understanding of enterprise and cloud integration patterns.

• Experience designing integrations for high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance.

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms i.e. AWS

• Experience building or consuming cloud-native services and APIs.

• Programming experience in Java, including scripting and automation.

• Familiarity with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.

Nice to Have / Desirable Skills

• IIB / ACE certifications.

• Experience with MuleSoft or ETL or data integration tools (e.g., Informatica).

• Unix/Linux and shell scripting.

• Experience supporting global, large-scale enterprise platforms

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation voucher
  • Meal/food vouchers
  • Childcare
  • Ginásio Pass
  • TCS Gems TCS Cares – toll-free 0800 that offers psychological (24 hours/day), legal, social and financial assistance to members
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online Courses & Live Training
  • Opportunity for international experience

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.
